oracle.description: templates/dispatch/tests/test_dispatch_release_capture.py decides correctness: fifteen fixtures, and nothing outside dispatch_release.py. Cut without re-authoring from the M-10 oracle written from the spec row by an author with no access to any implementation. Every fixture pins what it is guarding before asserting it, so a fixture that checks the capture did NOT happen cannot pass merely because there is no capture step at all.

purpose: Put the receipt and the worker's transcript on the packet branch, in templates/dispatch/scripts/dispatch_release.py. M-10a's scan_for_secrets already exists on main; call it, do not rewrite it. Add "receipt-capture" as the FIRST entry of PR_STEP_NAMES, before "commit", because the captured files have to be inside the commit M-9 added. Run the scan over the receipt AND the worker stdout together. When it is clean, write docs/evidence/receipts/<task_id>/receipt.json and docs/evidence/receipts/<task_id>/worker-stdout.txt inside the worktree, so the commit picks them up. The committed receipt.json must have the worker's stdout REMOVED and a short marker naming the sidecar and its byte count left in its place; worker-stdout.txt holds the transcript as text with its own newlines intact -- embedding it in JSON is what produced a 288 KB single line and broke ripgrep in every worker clone. When the scan finds anything, write NEITHER file, record the withholding and the pattern names under report["pr"]["receipt"], and carry on: a secret in a transcript must not turn a green packet into a failed one, and the record must never carry the secret itself. The receipt the driver already writes beside the worktree is unchanged and keeps its stdout; only the committed copy is split. report["pr"] records the capture and the repo-relative path of what was written. A failed capture sets report["pr"]["failed_step"] to "receipt-capture", writes exactly one workflow.escalation whose metadata step is "pr", exits non-zero and reaches neither the commit nor anything after it. A dry run captures nothing. A non-candidate disposition, a red gate and every L-2 stop condition reach no capture. Do NOT identify the PR sub-steps by their position in PR_STEP_NAMES: each must report its own name, or a later insertion shifts them all again -- that is the bug M-9 shipped and inserting receipt-capture at the head is exactly the insertion that caused it. Change nothing else: STEPS, RETRY_STEPS, STOP_CONDITIONS, MAX_GATE_ATTEMPTS, the L-4 retry, the L-2 stop conditions, scan_for_secrets and the M-9 commit all stay as they are. Do not generate a PR body or change pr_command; that is M-10b. Leave no debugging output behind: no print(), no temporary imports, no commented-out scaffolding in the final diff.
required_outcomes: PR_STEP_NAMES leads with receipt-capture, then commit, remote-add, push, pr-create
a clean receipt and transcript are captured into the worktree before the commit
the committed receipt.json has the stdout removed and names its sidecar and byte count
worker-stdout.txt is the transcript as text, newlines intact, never inside JSON
any finding withholds both files, records the names and not the secret, and the run still passes
the receipt beside the worktree is unchanged and keeps its stdout
a failed capture escalates once as the pr step and reaches nothing after it
a dry run, a non-candidate disposition, a red gate and every stop condition reach no capture
each PR sub-step failure reports its own name, not a positional neighbour

acceptance_properties.requirement: the capture leads the PR step
acceptance_properties.fails_when: PR_STEP_NAMES does not start with receipt-capture, or the capture runs after the commit

acceptance_properties.requirement: the transcript reaches the branch as text, not as JSON
acceptance_properties.fails_when: worker-stdout.txt is missing, its newlines are escaped, or the committed receipt still carries the stdout or fails to name the sidecar and its size

acceptance_properties.requirement: a secret withholds both files without failing the run
acceptance_properties.fails_when: either file is written on a finding, the run stops being a pass, or the recorded withholding quotes the secret instead of the pattern names

acceptance_properties.requirement: the receipt beside the worktree is left alone
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the driver's own receipt loses its stdout or is otherwise modified

acceptance_properties.requirement: a failed capture is a stop, not a silent skip
acceptance_properties.fails_when: failed_step is not receipt-capture, the escalation is not written once as the pr step, or the commit runs anyway

acceptance_properties.requirement: nothing that is not a real hand-off captures
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a dry run, a non-candidate disposition, a twice-red gate or any stop condition produces a capture
any sub-step reports a positional neighbour's name, or a failure does not stop every sub-step after it

non_goals: the bounded PR body and pr_command, which are M-10b
scan_for_secrets, which landed in #71 and is called, not rewritten
the .ignore files and the seven rewritten reports, already coordinator work in the §3c hand-pass
the receipt the driver writes beside the worktree, which keeps its stdout

retry_context.attempt_1_cause: coordinator defect: the oracle's two sub-step fixtures shared one worktree across their subTest loops, so four subTests could not be passed by any correct implementation. Fixed at starting_commit 625aa60.
retry_context.attempt_2_cause: not the oracle and not the tier. On the fixed oracle the worker produced 86 insertions in one file, left no debugging output, and scored 15/15 -- then the run was stopped at 1 435 896 tokens against a hard ceiling of 1 000 000, before gate could run.
retry_context.changed_for_this_attempt: hard_token_ceiling 1000000 -> 2000000 and soft 500000 -> 1200000, owner-approved 2026-08-24. The limits block had been copied unchanged from V5-M9 since M-9; observed spend on this packet is 1.4-1.5M, so the ceiling sat below what the packet costs. Cost was never the binding constraint: $0.15 against a $3.00 cap.
retry_context.attempt_counter_note: reset to 1 because the policy gate refuses attempt > max_attempts (2 on the host) and this is a materially revised packet. The two prior attempts are recorded here, in the escalation ad:01M0ST0EES9W09NR4EXFZCGBBE, and in docs/evidence/scorecards/v5-m-series.json; nothing about them is withdrawn.
